tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bid of the bidders whose contracts have been terminated/foreclosed in KPCL elsewhere during last three years and also who do not meet the above Pre-Qualifying Requirement will be rejected

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/documents furnished by the bidders, should the circumstances so warrant in overall interest of Corporation. In case, the information/ documents furnished are found to be incorrect/ invalid, then EMD will be forfeited
Bidders whose EMD has been forfeited/ contracts have been terminated/ foreclosed on account of their default in KPCL/elsewhere during past3years are not eligible to participate in the bid

The contractor shall run the canteens to the satisfaction of KPCL as per the directions given from time to time. In case of un-satisfactory performance, the Corporation reserves the right to cancel the contract and Security Deposit will be forfeited

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have experience in running canteen/Hotel and should upload Hotel/Canteen registration certificate and License to run canteen.

The intending bidder should have achieved an average annual turnover of Rs. 5.26 lakhs in at least two years during last five financial years(i.e.2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). As a proof the bidder shall upload scanned copies of turnover certificate OR profit & lossess statement duly certified by Chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactory completed one similar work(i.e. Providing/ Running canteen) of value not less than Rs.2.63 lakhs during the last preceding 5 years(i.e.2021-22,2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) and shall upload the work order and satisfactory work done certificate issued by Competant authority
